method.duplicates: Retained. No automatic deduplication and no claim of unique vehicles.
method.sourceSheet: dados (case-insensitive), plus owner-approved Plan1 in exactly 22 historical workbook/source-ID pairs. Other sheets ignored.
method.dates: Excel 1900/1904 serials, ISO and day-first strings; invalid and out-of-month rows quarantined from aggregates, retained privately.
method.scope: Segment scope derives from actual Segmento values. Filename suffix is contextual evidence only.
method.region: Derived from UF using the five official Brazilian geographic regions.
method.municipalityCode: Source municipality codes are not assumed to be IBGE codes.
method.fuel: Original source categories preserved; no automatic BEV/PHEV classification.
method.privacy: Public files contain aggregate dimensions and counts only. No CNPJ, company name, chassis or plate values.
method.missingDimensions: Kept under Não informado, never silently dropped.
method.sourceValues: Private analytical Parquet preserves all analytical input columns as strings plus salted diagnostic hashes. Direct identifiers exist only in restricted original workbooks. Formatting and formulas are not replicated as an Excel workbook.

scopeAudit.comparisonRule: Compare identical actual Segmento populations. All-segment totals can change scope across months.

bdClassification.join: Exact source year + numeric Modelo_Codigo; no fuzzy match or year backcast
bdClassification.annualSheetRule: Registration/source year YYYY joins only BD annual sheet YYYY
